title: HCP standard mesh atlas deformation spheres and ROIs (for fs_LR <-> fsaverage resampling)
authors: Washington University / HCP Pipelines (and the neuromaps package)
notes: Deformation spheres and cortex ROIs used to resample between the fs_LR 32k and fsaverage (164k) templates. The originals are the HCP Pipelines global/templates/standard_mesh_atlases files; the copies in this repo were bundled with and obtained via the Python package 'neuromaps' (hence the source_url). Purpose: the naive fs_LR 32k sphere is not in the same spherical coordinate system as FreeSurfer's sphere.reg, so these deformed spheres are required for correct wb_command -label-resample / -metric-resample.
